description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Added a game magnifier: when the input method covers the screen, tap the magnifier button to view the covered game area, with zoom and drag-to-pan support; "Show Magnifier by Default While Typing" can be enabled from the in-game right menu or the magnifier's settings (#1981).
2. SFPEW now works as a compatibility layer instead of a standalone renderer: it is stacked on top of the actual renderer to supply the legacy OpenGL fixed-function pipeline. Built-in renderers are handled automatically, and for renderer plugins it can be enabled under "Advanced" in the renderer selection dialog; it is skipped automatically when Angelica/Actinium is installed, and the EGL context mode is now chosen automatically (#1983).
3. The built-in MobileGlues was upgraded to 2.0.1: with the SFPEW compatibility layer it now supports all game versions (no longer limited to 1.17+); MultiDraw strategy ordering is now configurable (a global order plus independent per-function orders); the enableANGLE default now matches upstream.
4. NeoForge-related downloads gained a CurseForge CDN mirror candidate, and Emoji are no longer shown in mod Chinese names (synced from HMCL).
5. Fixed MultiMC modpacks (NeoForge, etc.) crashing on launch: game arguments were concatenated twice, making the loader throw an error; already-imported instances now launch normally without re-importing (#1984).
6. Fixed "Enable per-instance settings" being impossible to turn off for modpack versions: it was forcibly re-enabled on every version refresh.
7. Fixed the in-game keyboard toggle getting out of sync with the input method's actual visibility: after closing the keyboard with the input method's own key, reopening it required two taps.
8. Fixed the control-group visibility binding dialog pushing its buttons off-screen on small landscape screens and its dropdown text being hard to read in light mode (#1982).
9. Fixed the "Use System Vulkan driver" switch toggling without animation (#1993).
10. Removed MultiMC modpack export (importing MultiMC modpacks is unaffected).

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增游戏放大镜：输入法遮挡画面时可点放大镜按钮查看被遮挡的游戏画面，支持缩放与拖动平移；「输入时默认弹出放大镜」可在游戏右侧菜单或放大镜设置中开启 (#1981)
2.SFPEW 改为兼容层组合模式：不再作为独立渲染器，改为叠加在真实渲染器之上补齐旧版 OpenGL 固定管线；内置渲染器自动处理，插件渲染器可在渲染器选择对话框的「高级设置」中开启；装有 Angelica/Actinium 时自动跳过，并支持自动选择 EGL Context 模式 (#1983)
3.内置 MobileGlues 升级至 2.0.1：借助 SFPEW 兼容层支持全部游戏版本（不再限 1.17+）；新增 MultiDraw 方案排序配置（全局排序 + 按函数独立排序）；enableANGLE 默认值与上游保持一致
4.NeoForge 相关文件下载新增 CurseForge CDN 镜像候选；模组中文名不再显示 Emoji（同步 HMCL）
5.修复 MultiMC 整合包（NeoForge 等）启动崩溃：游戏参数被重复拼接导致加载器报错，已导入的实例无需重新导入即可正常启动 (#1984)
6.修复整合包版本无法关闭「启用游戏特定设置」：每次刷新版本都会被强制重新开启
7.修复游戏内键盘开关状态与输入法实际显隐不同步：经输入法自带按键收起键盘后，再次呼出需点两次
8.修复绑定控件组显隐对话框在小屏横屏下按钮被挤出屏幕、亮色模式下下拉框文字看不清 (#1982)
9.修复「使用系统Vulkan驱动」开关切换时无动画 (#1993)
10.移除 MultiMC 整合包导出功能（MultiMC 整合包导入不受影响）
